items.title: Frank Christian Interview, 1965-09-06
items.q: I played that Jada. I played that Jada on an old K record, I believe.

ctx.x: Can you tell us about the records you made up there? Do you remember when you made those, or what company, and what the tune was?
I played that Jada. I played that Jada on an old K record, I believe. I used to have that.
I don't have it, brother. Under your own name? As Frank? No.
